run_EpisodicMemoryRoboticFetch: run the episodic memory robotic fetch node to execute nav-pick-nav-place tasks on a Spot robot
run_nav_pick_nav_place: run the nav-pick-nav-place sequence to navigate, pick an object, navigate again, and place it
get_nav_xyt_to_object: get the navigation x,y,theta coordinates to navigate a robot to an object's pose of interest
get_nav_xyt_to_wearer: get the navigation x,y,theta coordinates to navigate a robot to face an Aria wearer with offset
get_place_xyz_to_wearer: get the local x,y,z coordinates for placing an object in the robot's local frame for handoff
